description:
Electrical wiring/schematic sheet for the aft hydraulic system automation, sheet 21 of 27. It shows three WAGO 2-channel digital-output modules, each TYPE 750-508 and associated with CPU 750-8213, at PLC positions 13, 14, and 15. Each output channel operates one named hydraulic directional-valve solenoid (six loads total) through a four-pin “CONNECTOR TYPE I”; each connector explicitly cross-references “see sheet 4.” No upstream branch protective device (breaker, fuse, switch, identifier, rating, or board/row) is drawn or named on this sheet, so the protective supply cannot be identified here. The module’s +/− field-power terminals are depicted, but no incoming power source identifier or rating is shown. No local switch, panel switch, interposing relay, contactor, or monitoring/alarm-system tap is shown; the only shown control points are PLC digital outputs. Signal/status wiring must not be inferred: none is drawn.

Circuit tracing by load:
1) Transom door CLOSE solenoid valve coil EV 10.1A: controlled by PLC digital output DO-03 CH 01 on 2DO module TYPE 750-508, CPU 750-8213, POS. 13. The CH01 switched conductor runs to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 1. Its paired return conductor runs from the module’s lower field terminal to connector pin 2. The external continuation/load connection is via CONNECTOR TYPE I and continues on “see sheet 4.” No protective device or supply rating is identified.
2) Transom door OPEN solenoid valve coil EV 10.1B: controlled by DO-03 CH 02 on the same POS. 13 module. The CH02 switched conductor runs to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 4; its paired return runs to pin 3. Continuation is on sheet 4. No protective device or additional control/monitoring point is shown.
3) Deck door OPEN solenoid valve coil EV 10.2A: controlled by PLC output DO-04 CH 01 on 2DO module TYPE 750-508, CPU 750-8213, POS. 14. CH01 runs to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 1; paired return runs to pin 2. Continuation: “see sheet 4.” No protective device/supply rating is shown.
4) Deck door CLOSE solenoid valve coil EV 10.2B: controlled by DO-04 CH 02 on POS. 14. CH02 runs to connector pin 4; paired return runs to pin 3. Continuation: sheet 4. No protective device or other control/monitoring point is shown.
5) Mainsheet traveler TO PORT solenoid valve coil EV 10.3A: controlled by PLC output DO-05 CH 01 on 2DO module TYPE 750-508, CPU 750-8213, POS. 15. CH01 runs to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 1; paired return runs to pin 2. Continuation: “see sheet 4.” No protective device/supply rating is shown.
6) Mainsheet traveler TO STBD solenoid valve coil EV 10.3B: controlled by DO-05 CH 02 on POS. 15. CH02 runs to connector pin 4; paired return runs to pin 3. Continuation: sheet 4. No protective device or additional control/monitoring point is shown.

Topology shown is PLC DO channel → connector switched pin, with the associated return terminal → paired connector pin; the actual valve coils and any upstream power protection are not drawn beyond these labelled circuit destinations. Sheet title block: SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg; HYDRAULIC SYSTEM AUTOMATION; section AFT; project SWS_108-1; client S.W. SHIPYARD; revision 4; date 05/05/2026.
